reason: The supposed hard four-side gap-network branch assumes the absence of a mixed Hamiltonian four/five-support. Choosing any two four-side vertices and any three interior-path vertices already forces a mixed Hamiltonian four-set, so that branch is impossible.
The gap-network disturbance analysis is unnecessary because the gap-network branch itself cannot occur: every 2+3 choice across the four-side and path interior contains a mixed Hamiltonian four-set.
The order-seven gap pattern is a specialization of an impossible hard branch; a mixed Hamiltonian four-set exists before gap-order analysis is needed.
The general 2|s balancing move gives strict descent without attachment analysis.
Phi-minimal states cannot contain any two-vertex component at all.
